spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पठति)
To speak articulately, to declaim, to recite or read.

m. (-ठः)
1 Studying the Vedas or scriptures, considered as one of the five great sacraments of the

Hindus.
2

Reading, perusal or study in general.
(-ठा)
A plant, commonly Aknidhi.
E.
पठ to read, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-ठन्-ठन्ती-ठत्)
Reading, reciting.
E.
पठ to read, शतृ part. aff.

n. (-नं)
Reading, reciting.
E.
पठ to read, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
Lecturing, teaching.
E.
पठ to read, causal v., ल्युट् aff.

Bdellium.
2
A kind of fish.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Readable, to be read.
E.
पठ to read, अनीयर aff.

f. (-री)
A Rāgiṇī, one of the wives of ŚRĪRĀGA.

f. (-री)
A small bird, commonly Sāri, (Gracula religiosa).

f. (-ठिः-ठी)
Reading, perusal.
E.
पठ to read, aff. इन्, ङीष् optionally added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Read, studied.
2 Recited, repeated.
E.
पठ to read, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Instructed, taught, lectured.
E.
पठ to read, causal v., क्त aff.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
To be read, what may or ought to be read.
E.
पठ to read, तव्य aff.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Reading, reciting, a reader.
E.
पठ to read, तृच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being read or recited.
E.
पठ to read, pass. v., शानच् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A lecturer, a public reader of the Purāṇas or other sacred works, or a Paṇḍita who declares what is the law or custom according to the scriptures.
2 A spiritual preceptor.
3 A reader, a student.
E.
पठ to read, ण्वुल् aff., or पठ, causal v., वुन् aff.

f. (-भूः)
A place where the Vedas are read or studied.
E.
पाठ reading, (the Vedas,) and भू place.

f. (-री)
A college, a school.
E.
पाठ study, शाला a hall.

f. (-णी)
A small bird: see पाठमञ्जरी.

m. (-ठी)
1 A plant, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
2 A Brahman, especially one who has finished his sacred studies.
E.
पाठ perusal, and इनि aff; the virtues of the plant are to be read of in medical works.

m. (-नः)
A sort of fish, (Silurus boalis, HAM.)
2 A public reader or lecturer on the Purāṇas, &c.
3 A tree: see गुग्गुल.
E.
पाठी a Brahman, and ईन् added

mfn. (-ट्यः-ट्या-ट्यं)
To be read or studied.
E.
पठ to read, ण्यत् aff.; also पठणीय, &c.
